newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 26.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Thursday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Major French supermarket and British department store plan to enter Japanese market as early as calendar year 1999.
-- Major personal computer firms to boost overseas production drastically.
-- Azabu Building president and executives arrested in asset-hiding case.
-- Government administrative reform panel to propose reorganising ministries.
-- Former Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) chairmen found okaying 1992 illegal loans to 'sokaiya' via affiliated finance firm.
-- Upper House member Tatsuo Tomobe and his wife and son plead not guilty to 'Orange' mutual aid society fraud charges.
